sentences.text: John Hovig Dolmayan -LRB- Ջոն Դոլմայան , born July 15 , 1973 -RRB- is a Lebanese-born Armenian -- American songwriter and drummer .	American	American Recordings (US)
He is best known as the drummer of System of a Down .	System of a Down	System of a Down
Dolmayan is also the drummer for the band Indicator and former drummer for Scars on Broadway .	Scars on Broadway	Scars on Broadway
His energetic live performances with System Of A Down over the years , have garnered him critical acclaim .
Loudwire listed him as one of the Top 50 Hard Rock + Metal Drummers Of All Time , with Dolmayan being ranked at # 22 .	Loudwire	Loudwire
